title: VTN Directory — Federated Search — payload
description: A search of the network's published set and, through their signed indexes, its member networks' sets. The same query as vtn/directory/search; every member is optional. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

membership.description: A person's membership credential from a member community, holder-bound to the signer; admits the person to a `members` directory.

Response.title: VTN Directory — Federated Search — response payload
Response.description: The matches, each with the network that lists it and its path, and the member networks that could not be searched.

determinedAt.description: When the network assembled the answer.

results.description: The matches, this network's own first (empty `path`), each stating its own state and whether it is a member of `listedBy`.

unreachable.description: Member networks whose sets could not be searched: indeterminate, not absent (VTI-REG-012).
